content: === Introduction ===
Dizzy is a nickname, Notable people with the nickname include:
<info> Hubert Raymond Allen (1919–1987), British Second World War Royal Air Force pilot and writer
<info> Dizzy Dean (1910–1974), Major League Baseball pitcher
<info> Dizzy Dismukes (1890–1961), American pitcher and manager in Negro league baseball and during the pre-Negro league years
<info> Benjamin Disraeli (1804–1881), British Prime Minister
<info> Dizzy Gillespie (1917–1993), American jazz trumpet player and composer
<info> Jason Gillespie (born 1975), Australian former cricketer
<info> Johnny Moore (trumpeter) (1938–2008), Jamaican trumpet player
<info> Dizzy Nutter (1893–1958), American baseball player
<info> Dizzy Reece (born 1931), jazz trumpeter
<info> Dizzy Reed (born 1963), Guns N' Roses keyboardist
<info> Dizzy Trout (1915–1972), Major League Baseball pitcher
